raw_response: {"translations":[{"id":"T0181","english":"Desklamp observation search strategy: prioritize open surfaces and systematically check containers"},{"id":"T0182","english":"When searching for the target object or desklamp, prioritize open surfaces related to the desklamp, such as desk, sidetable, nightstand, bed, armchair, coffee table, shelves, etc.; once the desklamp is observed, go directly to the furniture where it is located and use the desklamp if needed; do not continue traversing many drawers. If the reasonable open surfaces do not contain the target object, then systematically search by container type (drawer/cabinet), and after finding it return to the desklamp. Avoid repeatedly look/examine at the same location; when there is no new information, move to other furniture or containers. 'under the desklamp' does not guarantee that the target object or desklamp is necessarily at the assumed location, so when the assumed location is not visible, search other surfaces and containers."},{"id":"T0183","english":"When searching for the target object or desklamp in a desklamp observation task, or when you have reached the assumed desklamp location but the target object or desklamp is not there and repeated observations yield no new information."},{"id":"T0184","english":"First confirm the locations of the target object and desklamp; the desklamp is usually fixed on a furniture surface. If the desklamp has already been observed on a surface such as a desktop, side table, or dresser, go directly to that furniture; do not continue searching unrelated containers. When the target object is not at the desklamp, first obtain the target object and carry it to that furniture; when the target object is already at the desklamp, you can directly try to use the desklamp; if the interaction is not accepted, ensure the target object is in hand and retry. If the target object has already been obtained at the furniture where the desklamp is located, do not go to the same location again; directly use desklamp <id>. Successfully turning on the desklamp is the termination condition; do not append use/look after it."}]}
